source: BranchForm website type=url accepts syntactically validHTTP but ordinary submit sends bundled fields to local branch update. validatePublicContacts rejects non-HTTPS before branches.update; HTTPS is normalized by URL.toString. Backend uses ordinary session/superadmin checks, update scoped both branch and business. No website fetch, SMS, email or webhook call in this path. authority: The human authorized ongoing DEV WEB testing; a bounded reversible edit/restore of this existing isolated inactive test branch is within that scope. This does not create a fixture/entity or grant access, and does not invoke deletion, payment, message, notification or location permission. No authority inferred from code. Only proceed with fresh exact blank unmasked bundled baseline/no staff/services/bookings. Unknown/masked/unexpected values ->BLOCKED/noSubmit. No private contact input.
recovery: At most one rejected HTTP save attempt, one HTTPS save and one clear restore save. Original visible blank website and all fields restored. Physical null/empty representations and ordinary telemetry/auth writes unenumerated, never zeroTOTALwrites. If rejection unexpectedly persists HTTP, stop positive variant and only restore exact known website by one planned clear save; preserveFAIL.
